name: kelmo
description: KELMO — The Open Download Workspace. An open-source GPLv3 download manager for Windows and Linux.
author: KELMO Contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,yellow "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env KELMO_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage dir && bash scripts/make-rpm.sh && (bash scripts/make-deb.sh || echo "(.deb skipped: sudo dnf install dpkg, then npm run package:deb)")
scripts.dev:nosandbox: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,yellow "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env KELMO_DEV=1 electron . --no-sandbox"
scripts.test:engine: node --test engine/test/download.test.mjs engine/test/host.test.mjs engine/test/http.test.mjs engine/test/hash.test.mjs engine/test/hls.test.mjs engine/test/ytdlp.test.mjs engine/test/torrent.test.mjs
scripts.package:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir && bash scripts/make-deb.sh
scripts.package:rpm: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir && bash scripts/make-rpm.sh
scripts.dev:nogpu: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,yellow "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env KELMO_DEV=1 electron . --no-sandbox --disable-gpu"
scripts.test:bridge: node --test --test-concurrency=1 electron/test/bridge.test.mjs electron/test/extension.test.mjs electron/test/popups.test.mjs electron/test/power.test.mjs electron/test/media.test.mjs electron/test/secrets.test.mjs electron/test/clipboard.test.mjs electron/test/contextmenu.test.mjs electron/test/diaglog.test.mjs electron/test/native.test.mjs electron/test/opentarget.test.mjs electron/test/trash.test.mjs electron/test/videocache.test.mjs
